tools.name: get_access_and_permits
tools.description: Returns the permit entry and road access shown on a route's forecast page for a covered objective: the permit status, fee, notes and official link, and the road conditions for the approach passes, with highway, temperature, restrictions, the road agency named and the time its data was fetched. Road

tools.name: get_alerts
tools.description: Returns the NPS park alerts and National Weather Service fire weather alerts displayed for a covered objective, with source attribution and retrieval timestamps. ClimbCast does not carry current USDA Forest Service alerts or closures. Informational only.

tools.name: get_forecast_accuracy
tools.description: Returns stored public regional forecast accuracy, including observed-station or model-proxy truth lineage, data sufficiency, and eligibility. Takes either a region_id or an objective slug, which resolves to the accuracy region of the NWAC zone the objective is bound to. Informational only.

tools.name: get_hourly_conditions
tools.description: Returns the two-hourly temperature, wind speed, and wind direction shown in the hourly view of the forecast page's weather by elevation grid, for one day in the free forecast window, with local times, ISO timestamps, the time zone, and the chosen elevation. Takes a date from the route's visible days

tools.name: get_objective_conditions
tools.description: Returns public conditions for a covered objective: summit weather, the objective page's route list with grade, type, and round-trip distance, source provenance, and timestamps, in JSON or markdown. Covers up to five days. Daylight and air quality appear for the first day only, and get_trip_brief car

tools.name: get_route_conditions
tools.description: Returns up to five days of public route conditions, anchored to the route high point, with catalog gain, source provenance, and timestamps. An optional activity input selects one of the route's activities listed by search_objectives. Days can carry the avalanche center, bulletin state and forecast l

tools.name: get_trip_brief
tools.description: Returns the signed-out forecast page sections for a route in one call, covering up to five days, or one day with the date input: forecast days, daylight, air quality, and agency alerts, each with source provenance and a freshness status. Forecast days can carry the avalanche center, bulletin state a

tools.name: list_areas
tools.description: Lists the public coverage areas shown on the coverage directory, with each area's slug, name, state or province code, and visible activities. An area is a fixed geographic definition, not a distance from the caller. Its slug is the optional area input of search_objectives. Informational only.

tools.name: search_objectives
tools.description: Searches the public coverage catalog by name or alias, with optional region and activity filters. Coverage follows the current public scope. Region filters include WA, OR, and BC.
